findings.text: blocking: _whole_cell_rings makes a separate _normal_rings call before the lobe call at :184, so the remainder does not take its fan from the same call as the lobe as the exact done-when requires.

blocking: lobe_reference calls current._normal_rings at lobe_reference.py:124 with the booking's selection fields, so the dense lobe reference shares the region builder with the booking and cannot expose a common fan-geometry error despite the explicit independent-reference clause.

blocking: the partition table labels a 551-cell, zero-booked receipt as the 550-cell row, while maps2-lobe-500.json and cold2-lobe-500.json measure 550 cells from another cache; the required 550 carrier's owner partition has not been measured.

blocking: all added tests construct a private _cell_fan and call _ring_moments directly, never _whole_cell_rings or remaining_moments, so reinstating the vertex-list remainder defect leaves their three green assertions unchanged.

blocking: the prose says the 2,098 lobe error is 9.47260994768e-4 and passes a 1e-4 guard, but the measured value in the table and maps2-lobe-2000.json is 9.47260994768e-5; the published verdict is numerically self-contradictory.
blocking: the dispatch required baseline_suite and after_suite logs for a delta gate, but neither arm is recorded, so added_failure_count cannot be measured from the reviewed run.

follow-on: the new runner duplicates the existing lobe-plus-remainder versus closed-reference capability in scripts/prototypes/xpoint_cell_owner/lobe_reference_probe.py rather than extending that owner, creating two measurement paths that can drift.

follow-on: signed and whole-minus-part are all computed by _ring_moments from the test's own rings, so their agreement moves together under a common quadrature error; the independent uniform-density comparison at :130 is the assertion that checks the value.
follow-on: the 282 lobe error of 1.08655590095e-3 is only 4.409905e-8 below the 1.0866e-3 guard, whereas the prose says 6.5e-4 below it and materially overstates the margin.
follow-on: the committed file calls itself a scratch probe outside the node deliverable, adding a maintenance path with no role in the shipped booking or recorded gate.

item_verdicts.done_when: prompt.txt:98-106 requires independent 282, 550 and 2,098 partition checks plus map and cold rows; rows-inplace-250.json and rows-inplace-2000.json pass at 1.42108547152e-13 and 1.77635683940e-14, rows-inplace-500m.json instead measures 551 cells with empty lobes, maps2-1288883.out records three map guards passing, and cold2-1288884.out records the permitted 550 stall at 1.54987034401e-3.
item_verdicts.goal: prompt.txt:30 asks for each owner cell's lobe and remainder from one ring fan through the clip-quadrature owner, and lobe_booking.py:51 imports that owner and the 282 and 2,098 receipts agree within 1e-12, but lobe_booking.py:183-192 builds the cell and lobe with separate ring calls.

item_verdicts.write_paths: prompt.txt:70-74 grants scripts/prototypes/xpoint_cell_owner and the three named doc and figure paths, and git diff --name-status 80ee84b289d41d5a1bfbda8c3a5b94a7b2d7f1cd b49c5a4bb88ea94bbc4640bfbbecaffa5f3bcd3b lists nine files all inside them.

justifications.durability: test_lobe_partition.py:100 and :130 have independent closed-form expectations for the reduction, but :86 builds its own fan and no added test calls the changed remaining_moments or _whole_cell_rings, so restoring the vertex-list remainder would leave all three tests green.
justifications.evidence: lobe_partition_gate.py:124 uses a lobe reference built by the same ring routine as booking, its recorded 550 row uses 551 cells, and manifest.md:98-99 has no base and head suite arms, although the other numeric receipts are readable.
justifications.fit: lobe_booking.py:40-64 follows the surrounding JAX and private-helper idiom and introduces no forbidden source name, while docs/research/lobe-share-partition.html:175 contradicts its own measured map table by a factor of ten.
justifications.goal_fidelity: lobe_booking.py:183-192 calls current._normal_rings twice for the remainder, while the source goal requires the remainder to use the same call that builds the lobe, although the measured 282 and 2,098 partitions agree.
justifications.reuse: lobe_booking.py:51 wraps the existing clip_quadrature.py:378 owner and :104 calls current.py:82, but the added lobe_partition_gate.py:25 duplicates the lobe-plus-remainder reference comparison already owned by lobe_reference_probe.py:1-20 instead of extending that runner.
justifications.scope_discipline: all nine paths in the base-to-head diff are granted by prompt.txt:70-74, but fan_probe.py:1 is a committed scratch probe expressly described as outside the deliverable.
